blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) is probing possible masterminds and accomplices in the killing of former beauty queen and public school teacher Lullete Jane Ramino-De Guzman in Isabela following the arrest of the alleged gunman. The 30-year-old suspect was arrested by the Isabela Police Provincial Office’s Provincial Intelligence Unit and other police units in Barangay San Isidro, Rizal, on Nov. 23 under a warrant for murder with no bail recommended. De Guzman, a 2013 Miss Philippines Earth third runner-up, was gunned down on Feb. 13 by two motorcycle-riding suspects. READ: Gunman in slay of former Miss-Philippines Earth nabbed […]...
